plan: Since this is the first round, I have no history to learn from. My value is $46. I want to bid to maximize my expected profit. A simple strategy is to bid slightly below my value. I will bid $45.5. This allows me to win if the other bids are lower, and still make a profit. I will not bid my full value, as that would risk winning but making very little profit.
